findings.description: 0127 declares `Amends: 0021`, but `docs/adr/0021-debt-delta-three-soft-stages-with-a-merge.md` has no matching `- Amended by: [0127](...)` line (its header is only `- Status: accepted`). The ADR README says to add '`- Amends:` / `- Amended by:` lines for the cross-references the text states'. Existing pairs such as 0078 and 0036 are reciprocal, and 0036 carries `Amended by: 0078`.
findings.body:
ADR 0127 opens with `- Amends: [0021](0021-debt-delta-three-soft-stages-with-a-merge.md)`, but 0021's header has only `- Status: accepted` and never points back to 0127. A reader of decision 21 will not see that its complexity rule changed.

[`docs/adr/README.md`](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/6ea6bf4f5e00ff26e3790632394104c22dd35f23/docs/adr/README.md#L7-L9) says the header carries "`- Amends:` / `- Amended by:` lines for the cross-references the text states". Every other `Amends:` in `docs/adr/` has a matching `Amended by:` in its target, for example 0078→[0036](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/6ea6bf4f5e00ff26e3790632394104c22dd35f23/docs/adr/0036-gate-children-run-inside-a-pup-generated-sandbox.md#L4) and 0110→0017. 0127→0021 is the only pair without one. Existing ADRs show that adding this header line is not the "rewrite the landed text" the README forbids.

Fix: add this line to [`0021`](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/6ea6bf4f5e00ff26e3790632394104c22dd35f23/docs/adr/0021-debt-delta-three-soft-stages-with-a-merge.md#L3), directly after `- Status: accepted`:

```
- Amended by: [0127](0127-the-complexity-stage-judges-a-new-file-on-its.md)
```

findings.description: This JSDoc is now false. A file absent from before is judged on its absolute count against COMPLEXITY_NEW_FILE_FLAG_CAP (50), so the scale matters; ADR 0127 says so, but the comment still says it doesn't.

The new call-site comment repeats the JSDoc on `COMPLEXITY_NEW_FILE_FLAG_CAP` in `merge-gate.constants.ts`, which says 'judged on its own, not as a rise from zero (decision 127)'. AGENTS.md (Comments) says: 'A WHY comment that restates the callee's JSDoc is a duplicate: read the callee's docs before keeping it; if the seam already says it, delete the call-site copy.' Trim it, or delete it and let the constant's JSDoc and the ADR carry the why.

Both JSDocs say a file the target 'already holds' or 'does not hold', but the code keys on the before-measure list, which can leave out a file the target holds (ADR 0127 names that case). 'A file absent from the before-measure' would be accurate.

The `flatMap` returns `[{...}]` or `[]` in each of two nested branches and repeats the `{file, points, label}` shape twice. It would read more directly as a `map` that picks each file's `(points, limit, label)` followed by one `.filter((f) => f.points > f.limit)`. The behavior would be the same.

The new-file branch puts the adapter's raw `f.complexity` straight into the label and `points`. A custom complexity command whose output gives `"complexity": "

60"` still clears `> 50` and turns `points` into a string, so the description reads `+0

60`. The impact is cosmetic, since sanitizeReason flattens it. Fix: check `Number.isFinite` in custom.adapter's `matchesShape`.
